# Lantern Race (blueprint)

Each tap lights one of your seven lanterns. Light all seven first to win. When the 30-second fuse burns out, whoever
lit more wins; a level count is a draw.

## The rule (exact)

- Taps are `identify`: only who tapped and when matter.
- A tap lights the seat's next lantern. A second touch within `SETTLE_MS` (150 ms) of the seat's last is the same tap
  bouncing and lights nothing.
- `LANTERNS` = 7: the first seat to light all seven wins at once.
- `FUSE_MS` = 30000 after the start: the first tick or tap at or past it ends the game. More lanterns wins; equal is
  a draw (both stakes go back).

## Stations

- While it runs: `P1` / `P2`, the count as `3/7`, and `TAP TO LIGHT`.
- At the end: `WIN`, `LOSE` or `DRAW`, and how many that seat lit.

## The screen

The title on a brass plate, the fuse's seconds on an amber seven-segment readout, each player's row of lanterns on
their own side (Player 1 orange on the left, Player 2 cyan on the right). A tap pops the lantern it lit; the end
names the winner on a plate.
